svg.title: Fraud detection operating point — unweighted_logistic
svg.desc: Selected model: unweighted_logistic. Validation threshold: 0.053669. Untouched chronological test set: precision 82.6%, recall 76.0%, PR-AUC 0.8075; 57 true positives, 12 false positives and 18 false negatives.
svg.text: Threshold selected on validation · evaluated once on the chronological test set
Higher precision means a larger share of alerts are fraud.
Near-tie band: thresholds 0.032815–0.114460 stay within 5% of validation cost.
Cost alone does not set the production point; capacity and minimum precision still need an operating decision.
Frozen threshold applied once · 75 frauds / 56,962 transactions
No real fraud-review capacity was supplied.
operations, risk/finance, product and data science.
Chronological split · V1–V28 are anonymised PCA components, not customer-facing reason codes · portfolio case study, not a deployed bank fraud system.
